resultados.pergunta: Qual dia da semana concentra mais alertas críticos e qual linha lidera nesse dia da semana?

resultados.sql_unico:
WITH crit_per_day AS (
  SELECT c.dia_semana, COUNT(*) AS total_crit
  FROM alertas a
  JOIN calendario c ON date(a.criado_em) = c.data
  WHERE a.tipo = 'CRITICO'
  GROUP BY c.dia_semana
),
max_day AS (
  SELECT dia_semana
  FROM crit_per_day
  ORDER BY total_crit DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
crit_per_day_line AS (
  SELECT c.dia_semana, l.id AS linha_id, l.numero AS linha_numero, l.nome AS linha_nome, COUNT(*) AS total_crit
  FROM alertas a
  JOIN calendario c ON date(a.criado_em) = c.data
  JOIN linhas l ON a.linha_id = l.id
  WHERE a.tipo = 'CRITICO'
  GROUP BY c.dia_semana, l.id
),
max_line AS (
  SELECT dia_semana, linha_id, linha_numero, linha_nome, total_crit
  FROM crit_per_day_line
  WHERE dia_semana = (SELECT dia_semana FROM max_day)
  ORDER BY total_crit DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT m.dia_semana AS dia_da_semana, l.linha_numero, l.linha_nome, l.total_crit
FROM max_day m
JOIN max_line l ON l.dia_semana = m.dia_semana

       a.total_alertas_atencao,

) a
JOIN linhas l ON l.id = a.linha_id
JOIN (
    SELECT linha_id, COUNT(DISTINCT onibus_id) AS total_onibus
    FROM viagens
    GROUP BY linha_id
) v ON v.linha_id = a.linha_id

passos.entrada:
WITH cancelados AS (
  SELECT linha_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM viagens
  WHERE status = 'cancelada'
    AND data_inicio BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-11-03'
  GROUP BY linha_id
),
max_cancel AS (
  SELECT linha_id, cnt
  FROM cancelados
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT l.numero AS linha_numero,
       l.nome AS linha_nome,
       mc.cnt AS viagens_canceladas,
       COALESCE(COUNT(a.id), 0) AS alertas_criticos
FROM max_cancel mc
JOIN linhas l ON l.id = mc.linha_id
LEFT JOIN alertas a ON a.linha_id = l.id AND a.tipo = 'CRITICO' AND a.criado_em BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-11-03'
GROUP BY l.id, mc.cnt;
